LanguageData.VV_FailReason_EndingInProgress: No other rituals can be performed on this everflower while Dawn in full bloom is underway.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_RequiresEverflowerAltar: Must be enshrined on the everflower altar.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GrandAttunementLocked: Can only be performed after receiving the vivi federation's missive.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GrandAttunementInProgress: The final bloom is already underway.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GrandAttunementCompleted: The final bloom is already complete.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GrandAttunementFailed: The final bloom has failed and cannot continue.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_CoronationNotAnchor: Requires the everflower awakened by the full bloom ritual.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_CoronationLocked: Can only be performed once the bloom condensation is complete.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ReturnOfLife: {PAWN_labelShort}, an ancient vivi once bound to Apocrypha, has regained a body through the everflower's power and joined the colony.
LanguageData.VV_Message_AssimilationBegan: {PAWN_labelShort} has entered full assimilation with the everflower and risen into the air.
LanguageData.VV_Message_AssimilationReleased: The full assimilation with the everflower has ended, and {PAWN_labelShort} has descended to the ground.
LanguageData.VV_Message_AssimilationBrokenRitual: {PAWN_labelShort} has collapsed and her assimilation with the everflower is broken. The full bloom ritual has been called off.
